title: Console sidebar overlay at 1280 px: the first Esc is swallowed by a hidden nav-item tooltip and does not fold the overlay
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ③ ruling-directed. Ruling B on #26676 (6520722066, maintainer 「你可以自主验收合并，有问题会开新卡」) fixes a new card under #26676 as the remedy for a finding after a landing. Found by the post-merge proxy preview review of PR #27893 (#27593): comment 6521834471, on `main` `18318361`, `examples/app-crm`, evidence branch `claude/issue-27593-proxy-evidence` @ `e1844a1f` (`evidence/27593-proxy/`). The v4 boards do not draw the narrow-window sidebar, so "expected" comes from #27593's Acceptance and the seat's request 6514234395. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Business reason
Who: keyboard and mouse users who open the sidebar as an overlay on a narrow window. What happens: Esc looks broken. It takes two presses to fold the sidebar.

## Observed
- Expected (#27593 What to look at, item 2): one Esc folds the overlay.
- On `main`, the first Esc does not fold the overlay when the pointer rests on a nav item in it, or when keyboard focus is on a nav item or on **Keep sidebar open**. An invisible nav-item tooltip (`role=tooltip`, `display:none`) takes that press. The second Esc folds it.
- Surface: overlay sidebar, 1280 px, Contacts.

## Wanted
One Esc folds the overlay wherever the pointer or focus is inside it. A tooltip that is not shown does not take the key.

## Acceptance
- [ ] With the pointer on a nav item, and with focus on a nav item or on Keep sidebar open, one Esc folds the overlay. Pinned with an ablation.

Parent: #26676 · Refs #27593 · PR #27893
